headline: FARM BILL MOVES; EXPORT SALES PRINT AT 7:30
lead: The Senate Ag Committee broke its August deadlock Wednesday, advancing Farm Bill 2.0 on a 12-11 vote -- the first real legislative movement since the Aug 6 party-line failure. Beans settled at $13.26, off 3.5 cents, leaving the Nov contract a dime short of the level that would have triggered new-crop pricing for most operations.
teaser: Farm Bill clears committee; Export Sales prints at 7:30 with beans near 52-week highs.

one_number.unit: Senate Ag Committee vote, Farm Bill 2.0
one_number.context: The bill failed on a party-line vote Aug 6. Wednesday's McConnell-backed 12-11 advance puts it on the Senate floor ahead of the Sep 30 extension deadline.

yesterdays_call.note: Miss; beans settled $13.26, a dime short of $13.35, and the chart stalled at the week's high.
yesterdays_call.call_line: Called soybeans up toward $13.35 ($13.285 when the call was made). It closed at $13.2625.

action: New-crop beans: if Export Sales top 600K MT and Nov '26 closes above $13.42, price the first 10%.

sections.title: EXPORT SALES IN FOCUS
sections.body: - Beans at **$13.26** are at 98% of their 52-week range with no new demand catalyst overnight; the 7:30 CT Export Sales print is the only thing that can confirm this level or knock it back.
sections.so_what: Export Sales at 7:30 either confirms the level or sends beans hunting support.

sections.title: CRUDE EASES; DIESEL STORY DEEPENS
sections.body: - Crude fell to **$100.67**, off 1.6%, after Saudi Arabia confirmed it will reroute crude exports via Oman while the East-West pipeline is repaired, removing the acute supply-disruption fear that had kept the bid alive.
sections.so_what: Crude off its high, but diesel tightness is the real input-cost story for harvest.

outside_the_pit.title: Senate Ag Advances Farm Bill 2.0 on 12-11 Vote
outside_the_pit.body: The Aug 6 party-line failure is off the books.

watch_list.desc: Export Sales: beans above 600K MT confirms demand; below 300K MT hands the chart back to the funds.
Farm Bill deadline: full Senate floor vote is the next gate; no vote means another extension, not a bill.
Screwworm port reopening at Douglas, AZ: feeder supply returning; watch the feeder/live spread for the signal.

daily_quote.text: Coming together is a beginning; keeping together is progress; working together is success.

source_summary: USDA NASS, CME Group, Feedstuffs, OilPrice.com, Drovers, Fence Post, World Grain, No-Till Farmer
